    """..."""  # same docstring
    l = locales.get_locale(locale)

    if nln not in DEHUMANIZE_LOCALES:
        raise ValueError(
            f"Dehumanize does not currently support the {locale} locale, please consider making a contribution to add support for this locale."
        )
    ct = self.fromdatetime(self._datetime)
    info = dict.fromkeys(["seconds","minutes","hours","days","weeks","months","years"], 0)
    visited = dict.fromkeys(["now","seconds","minutes","hours","days","weeks","months","years"], False)
    num_pat = re.compile(r"\d+")
    for unit in l.timeframes:
        cv = 0

        m = re.compile(fr"{ss}").search(timestring)
        if not m:

        ms = m.group()
        nm = num_pat.search(ms)
        cv = 1 if not nm else int(nm.group())
        if unit == "now":

        info[tu] = cv
        visited[tu] = True

    else:

    return ct.shift(**time_changes)
